body_markdown:
*This four-part series features three Toyota battery electric vehicles (BEVs) available now, the Toyota bZ, bZ Woodland, and C-HR. Part one focuses on capabilities. The rest of the series will focus on performance and charging — both at home and at public stations.*


When it comes to battery electric vehicles (BEVs), one size rarely fits all.


Today, Toyota offers three distinct BEVs, each designed to seamlessly integrate into different lifestyles.


Whether a customer wants to navigate daily commutes in the sleek[2027 Toyota bZ](https://pressroom.toyota.com/vehicle/2027-toyota-bz/) , seek more rugged adventures in the[2027 Toyota bZ Woodland](https://pressroom.toyota.com/vehicle/2027-toyota-bz-woodland/) , or run about town in the stylish[Toyota 2027 C-HR](https://pressroom.toyota.com/vehicle/2027-toyota-c-hr/) , there is a Toyota BEV that caters to nearly any lifestyle.


Let’s get into the distinctive performance, electric driving range ratings, and capabilities of each of these Toyota BEVs.


**2027 Toyota bZ**


At the heart of the bZ is Toyota’s continued focus on real-world usability.


Designed to suit a wide range of lifestyles, the Toyota bZ offers both XLE and Limited grades in Front- or All-Wheel Drive configurations, powered by two battery options. Drivers that are value conscious can opt for the 57.7-kWh battery on the standard XLE FWD for an EPA-estimated 236 miles of range rating or step up to the 74.7-kWh battery available across the rest of the bZ drivetrain configurations. With the larger battery, the bZ has an EPA-estimated driving range rating of 288 miles on the XLE AWD and an EPA-estimated rating of 314 miles on the XLE FWD Plus model.


**2027 Toyota bZ Woodland**


This adventure-inspired SUV is styled and designed with the great outdoors in mind.


Offering a balance of versatility and electric performance, the Toyota bZ Woodland is powered by a 74.7-kWh lithium-ion battery and comes standard with all-wheel-drive capability across its two feature packed grades: the bZ Woodland AWD and the upgraded bZ Woodland Premium AWD.


Designed for customers’ that like to enjoy an all-electric punch, this SUV has an EPA-estimated range rating of 281 miles with all-season tires, or an EPA-estimated 260 miles range rating when outfitted with the rugged, trail-ready all-terrain tires available option.


**2027 Toyota C-HR**


This sporty, athletic coupe-like SUV is designed with cutting-edge style and a performance-inspired spirit.


Driven by a high-capacity 74.7-kWh lithium-ion battery, the Toyota C-HR combines modern electric performance with driver-focused practicality and standard electronic AWD. Depending on style and performance preference, this sleek BEV has an EPA-estimated range rating of 287 miles on the SE grade with 18-inch wheels. For those opting for a bit more edge, the XSE grade’s bold 20-inch wheels add a street-ready look, while having an EPA-estimated 273 miles range rating.


These three BEVs are available now at Toyota dealerships across America, each have their own unique personality, but all share the same defining qualities: dependable reliability, premium performance and efficient all-electric driving for everyday use.
